## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

Commodity-led market: USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND driving inflation and volatility narratives, while CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) shows industrial metals weaker.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy complex firm: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) and UNG RECOVERY (1W: +10.68% | 1M: -5.27%) reflecting commodity-driven flows.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%)) shows consistent 1W and 1M strength. DIVERGENCE: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) rising alongside commodity rallies and SPY/XLK BELOW TREND constitutes a major divergence that suppresses a clean risk-on call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor energy/commodity exposure given clear above-trend readings; reduce exposure to small caps and cyclical financials while monitoring volatility — bonds (TLT CORRECTION (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +2.56%)) remain a tactical hedge in mixed conditions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND if commodity momentum continues.  
BEARISH: Materials/Consumer Staples — XME BELOW TREND (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -9.45%) and XLP showing weakness on breadth.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude/Brent — USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) & BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND; BEARISH: Copper/Industrial metals — CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~35+ (elevated fear), HYG/LQD spread watch (credit health inflection), XLK/XLF pivot (~2.0) for style rotation, USO/BNO momentum break levels for commodity-driven risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) and HYG/LQD mixed signal provide confirmation. Energy showing relative strength — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) — while tech and small caps are weak. Key risk is the VXX/commodity-driven divergence versus equities (SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.01%)) — monitor volatility and credit spreads.
